# cooleryu Field Notes

Research notes on AI agent reliability, context management, and execution-time verification.

## Primary project
- ContextAdapt: https://github.com/cooleryu/ContextAdapt
- Description: Help every Agent use the smallest context that can still act safely.

## Published article
- How Much Code Context Does an AI Agent Need?: https://cooleryu.github.io/ContextAdapt/articles/how-much-code-context-does-an-ai-agent-need/
- Evidence level: REAL_CODE_RETENTION_HOLDOUT
- Direct result: +22.4 percentage points over head-and-tail truncation in strict held-out code-evidence retention.
- Boundary: this is not yet an end-to-end task-success, shortest-safe-tier, or provider-cost claim.
